id: title:TueHaulund:cut both thumbnail copies as webp in the rasterizer

review.posthog_relevance: Adds WebP support and small-width thumbnail parameters to the image processing pipeline, but the implementation is incomplete without changes to callers and configuration.
review.reason: The observed hunks demonstrate the addition of WebP format support and small-width thumbnail parameters to the image processing types and helper functions. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement. However, the chunk explicitly lacks the corresponding changes to the callers and configuration, meaning the change is not connected to a complete, usable feature. As
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the visible implementation of the new parameters and types, but the lack of caller and configuration changes prevents assigning a higher tier or assessing the full operational benefit. The score reflects the maintenance and implementation effort rather than the realized product benefit.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the corresponding changes to the callers of extractThumbnails, nor does it show the configuration or API changes that would enable the new small_width and image_format parameters. Without those, the added parameters are not connected to a complete, usable change. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds webp to FORMAT_META and its union type, and adds smallWidth and image_format fields to FrameSource and ExtractThumbnailsInput, and small_s3_uri to ExtractThumbnailsOutput.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds support for WebP image format and a small-width thumbnail option, but the callers and configuration are not shown, so the change is not complete.

observations.behavior: Adds webp to the format union type and its default value, and adds smallWidth and format fields to FrameSource, and the WEBP_QUALITY constant.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows WebP as an output format and small-width thumbnails, but the callers and configuration are not shown, so the change is not complete.

observations.behavior: Adds smallWidth and format fields to FrameSource, and the WEBP_QUALITY constant, and the image_format and small_width parameters to withFrameSource, and the smallWidth and format fields to the FrameSource returned by withFrameSource, and the encoderArgs and outputSize functions, and the smallPath parameter to cutFrame, and the smallSize field to the return value of cutFrame.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows small-width thumbnails and WebP output, but the callers and configuration are not shown, so the change is not complete.
